candidate.title: Risks of AI scientists: prioritizing safeguarding over autonomy.
candidate.abstract: AI scientists powered by large language models have demonstrated substantial promise in autonomously conducting experiments and facilitating scientific discoveries across various disciplines. While their capabilities are promising, these agents also introduce novel vulnerabilities that require careful consideration for safety. However, there has been limited comprehensive exploration of these vulnerabilities. This perspective examines vulnerabilities in AI scientists, shedding light on potential risks associated with their misuse, and emphasizing the need for safety measures. We begin by providing an overview of the potential risks inherent to AI scientists, taking into account user intent, the specific scientific domain, and their potential impact on the external environment. Then, we explore the underlying causes of these vulnerabilities and provide a scoping review of the limited existing works. Based on our analysis, we propose a triadic framework involving human regulation, agent alignment, and an understanding of environmental feedback (agent regulation) to mitigate these identified risks. Furthermore, we highlight the limitations and challenges associated with safeguarding AI scientists and advocate for the development of improved models, robust benchmarks, and comprehensive regulations.
candidate.authors: Tang X, Jin Q, Zhu K, Yuan T, Zhang Y, Zhou W, Qu M, Zhao Y, Tang J, Zhang Z, Cohan A, Greenbaum D, Lu Z, Gerstein M.

extraction.method: AI科学家风险界定与三元防护框架
extraction.data: 无实证数据；基于文献与案例的概念分析
extraction.scenario: AI科学家安全治理与风险防控
extraction.benchmark: 无定量基准；以抗体合成等流程示例说明风险
extraction.results: 提出人类监管、智能体对齐、智能体监管与环境反馈三元防护框架
extraction.limitations: 为观点性论文，无实证验证；风险分类非互斥
extraction.summary: 该观点论文界定并梳理“AI科学家”的风险，主张优先系统防护而非追求更强自主性。作者从用户意图、科学领域与环境影响三方面分类风险，并提出人类监管、智能体对齐、智能体监管与环境反馈组成的三元防护框架。论文以抗体合成等流程示例说明各步骤潜在错误与危害，呼吁在AI科学家研发中落实负责任与安全导向。
